findings.title: Malformed environment variable names
findings.description: The environment variable names galaxy_rayWAY_PUBLIC and galaxy_rayWAY_SECRET are syntactically invalid and will not be read at runtime. Appears in 18+ locations across config files, source code, and documentation. Should be GALAXYRAY_PUBLIC/GALAXYRAY_SECRET or GALAXY_RAY_PUBLIC/GALAXY_RAY_SECRET.

findings.title: Workflows still use old variable name
findings.description: .github/workflows/ci.yml and release.yml reference STELLAR_GATEWAY_PUBLIC in docker run commands. Should be updated to match the renamed environment variable once the malformed name issue is fixed.

findings.title: Cargo.lock not updated
findings.description: Cargo.lock still references name = "stellargate" at line 2502. Will be regenerated on cargo build, but represents inconsistent state if committed to the repository.
